title: CineLark Remote Pairing QR Payload
description: Sensitive, short-lived endpoint and pinning material encoded in a QR code. Production values must never enter diagnostics or fixtures.

platform.description: Host operating system used only for device presentation.

host.description: An endpoint hint, not server identity.

fingerprint.description: Base64URL without padding of SHA-256 over the server certificate DER.

secret.description: Base64URL without padding of a 256-bit single-use pairing secret.
